items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: The interviewee Bernard Steinau does not speak in the provided transcript. The mention of Freddie Landry is made solely by the [INTERVIEWER] ('I even knew Freddie Landry from there').

ctx.x: No, but they were important. Well, at that time it was considered because it was, let's see, it was two saxes. And they had probably a few guys from Downsville. That's one from the Downsville band. Oh, yeah.

I even knew Freddie Landry from there, he used to play around there. Gosh, what was that band that was so famous for? Um, Dowson, you know, and... Well, it'll come to me after a while. Freddie was one of the... I guess it was Williams.
